rongmei.title: Ai rui tigun daina neihlaa bam ni

lines: 1. Ai rui tigun daina neihlaa bam ni,
Rih pingpui tuang makpui ram khou tei,
Hei kandi khou rui phaeng hou tang ngam mak;
Mi ram tangh khang tei nkhuan ngam mak.
Tingmik thui zuanni ai guangtang maksan,
Nzian lou mei gaanpui ram khou tei,
Meiguai na rui hei tei ning thuk sini,
Sa ngam makge ai karam gai tei.
2. Kabumaeng rianrana maan kanmei khou
Khrista zianlou mei ring pui lat hei,
Aniu ta ti thai loupui zaeng khou rui,
Hallelujah thuan ku tak lak khe.
3. Hei kum pui kan khou zaat kapum na rui,
Katik kagunh daimei bampaeng khou,
Kanloumei pu katik kagun daimei
Houpui kan khou thuan ku puni the.
4. Kandi rianra pui ram khou bamsan hei,
Tingmik thui rianra mei rui duamliam,
Kanloumeipu hu khou ding pui kan khou.
Rian ramei hei neihla mei suni.
5. Heikum ma kanloumei lumloumei nun,
Tingseic laukhuan gaanphiu gan gaimei,
Akhang suni poubaomei nzianmei,
Tingsaeng neihlamei lusuan bam ni.
